narrative.overview: Lemely is a paperclip. It is small, precise and cool to the touch, and its job is to hold things together: a student's papers, a teacher's class set, a term of progress. The system is one colour at two depths: Abyss (#042f4f) carries light mode and Tide (#7fb8e0) carries dark mode, both from the same Material 3 tonal palette. Teachers, parents and schools get "Every mark, explained.": calm tonal surfaces, monospace data, no mascot. Students get "From paper to A*.": the same surfaces with Binny, XP, streaks and Bricolage Grotesque at full size for the moments that earned it.
keyCharacteristics: Material 3 colour roles only. UI code never uses a raw value when a role exists.
Cool neutrals at hue 240. No browns, no warm paper, no very dark reds.
Three typefaces with fixed jobs: Bricolage Grotesque for display, Schibsted Grotesk for everything readable, JetBrains Mono for data.
Flat tonal layering. A 1 to 1.5px outline appears only where white sits on white.
Generous, rounded geometry: cards 24, tiles 20, buttons 14, chips 12.
Binny the binder-clip bunny appears on student surfaces only.

rules.name: The Roles Only Rule
rules.body: UI code uses Material 3 roles (--md-primary, --md-surface-container-low, ...), never raw values. Theme switching swaps role values, not component code.

rules.name: The Never Abyss On Dark Rule
rules.body: On Night or any dark surface, the brand accent is Tide. Abyss on dark reads as a hole.

rules.name: The Red Means Lost Rule
rules.body: Crimson appears only on lost marks, low confidence and genuine errors. Never as decoration, a background wash, or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Gold Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on XP, streaks and reward moments (plus the medium-confidence dot). If nothing was earned, there is no gold.

rules.name: The Letter Always Rule
rules.body: A grade chip always shows its letter. A* is always green.

rules.name: The T1 Over 28 Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque appears at 28px and above only. Below that, use Schibsted.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Measured Rule
rules.body: Every mark, score delta, code and confidence value is set in JetBrains Mono or with tabular figures. Confidence is a percentage ("64%"), never a 0 to 1 decimal.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only on hover or on a floating panel.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: To raise something, step it one rung up the surface ladder before reaching for a shadow or an outline.

dos: Do use Material 3 roles in code. Abyss #042f4f is primary in light mode and Tide #7fb8e0 is primary in dark mode.
Do use the audience line: "From paper to A*." for students, "Every mark, explained." for teachers, and "Turn past papers into progress." for parents and schools.
Do set every mark, delta, code and confidence value in JetBrains Mono. Show confidence as a percentage.
Do raise surfaces by stepping up the tonal ladder. Use a 1 to 1.5px outline only for white on white.
Do show the letter on every grade chip, and keep A* green.
Do connect every number to a next step ("Two topics need attention this month").
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: all motion off, Binny included.
Do keep teacher copy precise and efficient: "14 answers below 70% confidence are waiting for your review."
donts: Don't put Abyss on a dark surface. On dark, the accent is Tide.
Don't use crimson for anything except lost marks, low confidence and genuine errors.
Don't use gold anywhere nothing was earned.
Don't show Binny on teacher, parent or school surfaces, show more than one Binny on a screen, or place Binny next to the logo.
Don't bring back the retired Study Notebook kit: warm paper, Caveat handwriting, pastel stickers, paper texture, brown or warm neutrals.
Don't build generic SaaS dashboards: metric cards with gradient shadows, the HubSpot/Salesforce template.
Don't use consumer edtech gamification: Duolingo-style emoji as UI, confetti, bright primary colours, cheerleader copy.
Don't use the "AI product" look: purple-blue gradients, dark glassmorphic panels, neon accents on near-black.
Don't use academic or institutional aesthetics: Times New Roman, university portal greys, government-form layouts.
Don't build cookie-cutter card grids of equal-height identical boxes with colour used as decoration.
Don't use border-left or border-right over 1px as a coloured stripe, or gradient text.
Don't tilt the paperclips, or change the clip stroke from 5.
